files.README.md:
# mongodriver-mongodb-from-model2db-validators

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities, repositories and services with the MongoDB driver, in C# for .NET 10. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: mongodb.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return DTOs (records); updates take a Patch<T> per field: absent, null or a value.
- Transactions: every repository write is committed at once.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/App/Database.cs              opens the database DATABASE_CONNECTION names
src/App/Db.cs                    a database and the session of its transaction
src/App/Documents.cs             what changed in a document
src/App/IUnitOfWork.cs           the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/App/Errors/                  NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/App/Entities/                one entity per table
src/App/Repositories/            the repositories of each table
src/App/Services/                one service per table
tests/App.Tests/                 repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json               what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
TEST_DATABASE_CONNECTION="mongodb://localhost:27017/app" dotnet test   # a real, disposable database: it is dropped and created again; transactions need a replica set
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <OutputType>Exe</OutputType>
    <IsPackable>false</IsPackable>
    <RootNamespace>App.Tests</RootNamespace>
    <!-- The tests share one database and run one after another: no cancellation to pass on -->
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);xUnit1051</NoWarn>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="xunit.v3" Version="4.0.3" />
  </ItemGroup>
  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="../../src/App/App.csproj" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
